description: This file defines a subclass of a Starlette UploadFile, adding additional properties and asynchronous methods for reading, writing, seeking, and closing files uploaded via FastAPI. It also includes internal utility classes and functions related to default value management.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A specialized file class for handling uploaded files in FastAPI, extending Starlette's UploadFile with additional async methods and properties for file metadata.
